mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(u.system_trade_id, u.ai_correct_trade_id) AS trade_id, u.sec_uid, DATE(d.live_start_date) AS stat_date, d.total_watch_num_confuse AS total_watch_num, d.average_online_num_confuse AS average_online_num, d.average_residence_time_confuse AS average_residence_time, d.increment_follower_count_confuse AS increment_follower_count, d.convert_fan_rate_confuse AS convert_fan_rate, d.interaction_percent_confuse AS interaction_percent, d.volume_start_confuse AS volume_start, d.volume_end_confuse AS volume_end, d.purchase_count_start_confuse AS purchase_count_start, d.purchase_count_end_confuse AS purchase_count_end, d.customer_unit_price_start_confuse AS customer_unit_price_start, d.customer_unit_price_end_confuse AS customer_unit_price_end, d.uv_value_start_confuse AS uv_value_start, d.uv_value_end_confuse AS uv_value_end, d.goods_convert_rate_start_confuse AS goods_convert_rate_start, d.goods_convert_rate_end_confuse AS goods_convert_rate_end, d.volume_start_confuse / d.total_watch_num_confuse * 1000 AS gpm_start, d.volume_end_confuse / d.total_watch_num_confuse * 1000 AS gpm_end FROM tb_video_data_viewing d INNER JOIN tb_anchor_url u ON d.anchor_number = u.anchor_number WHERE d.live_start_date >= #{dayStart} AND d.live_start_date < #{dayEnd} AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, d.live_start_date, d.live_end_date) > 3000 AND d.is_deleted = 0
